CUSTODIAL AND GROUNDS MAINTENANCE SERVICES
SHENANDOAH VALLEY FEDERAL BUILDINGS – WINCHESTER, HARRISONBURG AND STAUNTON, VIRGINIA

U.S. General Services Administration, Public Buildings Service, Mid-Atlantic Region (3PQ)

Excerpts: Section B Schedule, Section C Performance Work Statement, Section J Exhibit J.1

Solicitation issuedSeptember 2, 2026
Amendment 0001 issuedSeptember 18, 2026
Offers dueOctober 30, 2026, 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time
NAICS / size standard561720 Janitorial Services / $22.0 million
Type of contractFirm-fixed-price, with Above Standard Services ordered on a fixed-unit-price basis

SUMMARY OF CHANGES – AMENDMENT 0001

Item 1. Building VA0355ZZ, Federal Records Annex, 640 Commerce Road, Staunton, VA, is deleted from the scope of this solicitation in its entirety (building reported excess and scheduled to be vacated before contract start). Section C.1.1 is revised from “six (6) buildings” to “five (5) buildings.” CLIN 0001AF and the corresponding option-period CLINs are deleted. The Exhibit J.1 sheet for VA0355ZZ is retained in this conformed copy for reference only and shall not be priced.

Item 2. Exhibit J.1, Building VA0241ZZ, Section C: Office / general administrative space is revised from 13,930 to 15,330 square feet to add second-floor Suite 210 (1,400 SF), and the Total Custodial (Cleanable) Square Feet is revised from 21,460 to 22,860. CLIN 0001AC is revised accordingly.

Item 3. Responses to questions received by September 11, 2026:

Q1. Do the Gross Square Feet in Exhibit J.1 include basements and the office mezzanine at VA0402ZZ? A1. Yes. Gross square feet include all floors, basements, mezzanines and penthouses. Exhibit J.1 shows floors above grade and below grade separately; the total number of floors is the sum of the two.

Q2. Is the child care center at VA0187ZZ part of the custodial square footage? A2. No. The child care center is cleaned by the child care provider and is listed in Exhibit J.1 for information only.

Q3. Who is the incumbent contractor and what is the value of the current contract? A3. The current contract, 47PC0321C0042, was awarded in December 2021 to Caldera Ridge Facility Services, LLC for a base year and four option years (60 months, March 1, 2022 through February 28, 2027). The total awarded value including all options is $5,612,350. The value of the current option year (Option Year 4) is $1,146,880. The current contract includes VA0355ZZ. This information is provided for reference only.

Q4. Are the exterior glass square feet one side or both sides? A4. One side. Window washing of interior and exterior surfaces is required once per year at each building, and twice per year for the exterior of VA0123ZZ (see C.3.10).

Q5. Is parking lot plowing part of the firm-fixed price? A5. No. Snow and ice removal from entrances, steps, ramps and walks is a standard service at buildings marked “Yes” in Exhibit J.1, Section F. Plowing of parking lots and driveways will be ordered as an Above Standard Service under CLIN 0003.

Solicitation No. 47PC0326R0014 (Conformed through Amendment 0001) — Shenandoah Valley Federal Buildings Section C – Page C-1

SECTION C – PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT (EXCERPT)

This PWS is tailored from the GSA National Consolidated Maintenance Specification and National Custodial Specification. Paragraphs not reproduced in this excerpt are incorporated by reference.

C.1 GENERAL

C.1.1 Scope. The Contractor shall furnish all management, supervision, labor, materials, supplies and equipment, and shall plan, schedule, coordinate and assure effective performance of custodial and grounds maintenance services at the five (5) buildings identified in Exhibit J.1, Building Information Sheets.

C.1.2 Building Information Sheets. A Building Information Sheet (Exhibit J.1) is provided for each building covered under the contract. The custodial square feet shown in Exhibit J.1 were prepared with the GSA Custodial Square Footage Tool and include only the square feet that will be cleaned on a routine basis; square feet that will not be cleaned routinely, such as mechanical and electrical rooms, telecommunications closets and file room storage, have been removed. Gross, rentable and ABOA square feet are provided for information only. Space cleaned by others is listed in Exhibit J.1 for information and is not part of the custodial square footage.

C.1.3 Period of Performance. The period of performance is a twelve (12) month base period beginning March 1, 2027, and four (4) twelve-month option periods, for a total of five (5) years if all options are exercised. Services may be extended up to six (6) additional months under FAR 52.217-8.

C.1.4 Hours of Work. Normal working hours for each building are shown in Exhibit J.1. Unless otherwise stated in Exhibit J.1, custodial services shall be performed after normal working hours, Monday through Friday, excluding Federal holidays. Services shall not be performed on Saturdays, Sundays or Federal holidays except as ordered under C.15.

Solicitation No. 47PC0326R0014 (Conformed through Amendment 0001) — Shenandoah Valley Federal Buildings Section C – Page C-2

C.3 STANDARD CUSTODIAL SERVICES

C.3.1 Service Levels. All custodial space shall be maintained to the standard of cleanliness defined in this PWS. The frequencies below are minimums and apply to every building unless Exhibit J.1 states otherwise. Where a frequency of “daily” is shown, the task shall be performed once each workday, or once per shift where multiple shifts are provided.

TaskMinimum Frequency
Restrooms: clean and disinfect water closets, urinals, lavatories, showers and partitions; restock soap, paper and linersDaily
Restrooms: machine scrub floors and grout; clean walls and partitionsMonthly
Trash and recycling removal to designated collection pointsDaily
Entrances and lobbies: sweep, damp mop, vacuum walk-off mats; spot clean entrance glassDaily
Carpet: vacuum traffic areas and spot cleanDaily
Carpet: vacuum wall-to-wall, including under furnitureWeekly
Carpet: hot-water extraction of traffic lanes / wall-to-wallQuarterly / Annually
Resilient and hard floors: dust mop and damp mopDaily
Resilient floors: scrub and recoat / strip and refinish2x per year / Annually
Stairwells: sweep and damp mop treads and landings (handrails daily)Weekly
Elevator cabs: clean doors, walls, tracks and floorsDaily
Dust horizontal surfaces to 7 feet; clean drinking fountainsWeekly / Daily
Glass within ten (10) feet of the floor (doors, sidelights, partitions): spot cleanDaily
High dusting above 7 feet, vents, diffusers and light fixturesAnnually
Warehouse and shop floors: sweep / machine scrubWeekly / Monthly
Storage and file rooms included in custodial square feet: trash, vacuum or dust mopMonthly
Interior and exterior window washing (C.3.10)Annually

C.3.4 Courtrooms and Chambers. At VA0123ZZ courtrooms, judges’ chambers and jury rooms shall be cleaned after court adjourns, under escort when required by the U.S. Marshals Service.

C.3.5 Public Areas. At VA0318ZZ the public waiting room, interview-window glazing and public restrooms shall be cleaned daily; mid-day restroom checks are ordered under C.15.

C.3.6 Health Units. Health unit space shall be cleaned and disinfected daily using EPA-registered hospital-grade disinfectants.

Solicitation No. 47PC0326R0014 (Conformed through Amendment 0001) — Shenandoah Valley Federal Buildings Section C – Page C-3

C.3.8 Historic Finishes. At VA0241ZZ (National Register listed) marble treads, terrazzo and wood trim shall be cleaned with neutral cleaners only. No abrasive pads or acid cleaners shall be used.

C.3.10 Window Washing. Windows shall be cleaned once per year, interior and exterior surfaces, including sashes, frames, sills and mullions, at each building. At VA0123ZZ the exterior glass shall be cleaned twice per year, in April and October. Exterior glass areas in Exhibit J.1 are one-side measurements. Additional window washing requested by tenant agencies shall be ordered as an Above Standard Service under C.15 on a reimbursable basis. Work above the first floor shall comply with OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Subpart D and ANSI/IWCA I-14.1.

C.3.11 Snow and Ice Removal. At buildings marked “Yes” in Exhibit J.1, Section F, the Contractor shall remove snow and ice from building entrances, steps, ramps and walks within two (2) hours after accumulation of one (1) inch or more, and before the start of normal working hours. Heavy snow removal and plowing of parking lots and driveways shall be ordered under C.15.

C.4 GROUNDS MAINTENANCE

C.4.1 Scope. Grounds maintenance applies to buildings marked “Yes – Contractor” in Exhibit J.1, Section F. The Contractor shall maintain the landscaped / improved grounds, parking areas and sidewalks listed in Exhibit J.1. Total site area is shown for information only and includes building footprints, wooded buffers and areas maintained by others.

C.4.2 Mowing. Improved turf shall be mowed weekly from April 1 through October 31 (approximately 30 cuts per season) and as needed in March and November, to a height of 2½ to 3½ inches, with trimming and edging of walks, curbs and beds at each mowing.

C.4.3 Planting Beds, Leaves and Litter. Shrubs shall be pruned twice per year; beds shall be weeded monthly and mulched annually. Leaves shall be removed weekly from October 15 through December 15. Litter shall be policed from all grounds, parking areas and walks daily.

C.4.4 Parking Areas and Walks. Parking areas shall be swept monthly and walks blown or swept weekly. Pavement repair and line striping are excluded.

C.15 ABOVE STANDARD SERVICES

Above Standard Services are services beyond those described in C.3 and C.4, ordered in writing by the Contracting Officer at the fixed unit prices in Section B, including after-hours special cleaning, additional window washing, day-porter restroom checks, carpet extraction beyond the scheduled frequency, and snow plowing of parking lots and driveways.
